import json, subprocess as S, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
a = sys.argv
p = S.Popen([a[1], 'mcp'] + a[3:], stdin=S.PIPE, stdout=S.PIPE, stderr=S.PIPE)
def w(m):
    p.stdin.write((json.dumps(m) + '\n').encode()); p.stdin.flush()
def r(i):
    for line in p.stdout:
        m = json.loads(line)
        if m.get('id') == i:
            return m
    raise SystemExit('server closed stdout: ' + p.stderr.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
w({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 1, 'method': 'initialize', 'params': {'protocolVersion': '2025-06-18', 'capabilities': {}, 'clientInfo': {'name': 'nested-probe', 'version': '1'}}})
r(1)
w({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'method': 'notifications/initialized'})
for n, (t, g) in enumerate(json.loads(a[2])):
    w({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': n + 2, 'method': 'tools/call', 'params': {'name': t, 'arguments': g}})
    m = r(n + 2); res = m.get('result') or {}
    txt = ' '.join(c.get('text', '') for c in res.get('content', [])) or json.dumps(m.get('error'))
    print(('ERROR ' if res.get('isError') or 'error' in m else 'OK ') + t + ': ' + txt.replace('\n', ' '))
p.stdin.close()
print('STDERR ' + p.stderr.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace').replace('\r', '').replace('\n', ' | '))
p.wait(15)
